commands.review_summary:
The PR changes core session rollover persistence and clears rotated session metadata so Discord STT/TTS turns can reuse the newly persisted session after a stale-session rollover, with a regression test in `src/commands/agent.test.ts`.

PR surface: Source +3, Tests +50. Total +53 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for source-level reproduction: current main rejects persistence when a stale stored session id is replaced by a new id, and the PR test targets that path. I did not run a live Discord voice setup in this read-only review.
